brief: A pierhead light at the end of a concrete breakwater: a square tapering white steel tower about 20 m tall with small windows and a black lantern with a railed gallery, standing on a concrete pier deck, sand dunes behind. Two photos. Older than 1970: Great Lakes pierhead lights predate 1970. Piles 10 m below the bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Frankfort MI North Breakwater Light (1912, moved 1932): a square, tapering white steel pyramidal tower about 20 m tall with small portholes and a black gallery and lantern, on the end of a low concrete breakwater; waves breaking over the crib

why.note: harbour entrances on the lakes are marked by pierhead lights at the ends of the breakwaters; islands and points by a light with a keeper's house
